subject: artifacts/current-windows-20261019/retain_isolation_depth_history.py

findings.issue: Historical observations are not fully tied to the actual captured command result
findings.evidence: child is compared to row.observed, but the child summary's research_result, targets, sample_count, concurrent sample count and progress are not compared to observations.json. The hash-checked actual-isolation.log is not parsed back to that child result. require_timeout receives process_exit_code=2 as a literal rather than the actual captured concurrent-research command exit. Consequently a changed observations.json can supply different retained measurements without disagreeing with these checks
findings.minimal_fix: Parse the already captured actual-isolation.log JSON and require exact child equality; require every duplicated child observation field to match; derive counts from the captured process/protection samples. Require the canonical concurrent-research command row, its actual exit/reaping facts and hash-checked log, then parse the same captured log bytes and compare its actual result. Validate the recorded probe awake restoration as part of the closure
findings.minimal_regression: Use isolated public fixtures to change observations research_result or a count while preserving the actual child/outer log; each must reject. A captured concurrent command exit other than 2 must reject even if observations carries a valid-looking timeout result

findings.issue: The first tracked-write admission gate bypasses protected bounded capture
findings.evidence: qualify/checkpoint.json, owning-memory/checkpoint.json and the successful primary disposition are read with ordinary Path.read_bytes before CapturedEvidence exists. A redirected or multi-link fixed path therefore reaches an ordinary read rather than the existing protected reader; the exact admission bytes are also absent from the captured history commitments. The gate does not check exact stage/kind/attempt or consistency between selected qualifier and observer outcome
findings.minimal_fix: Create CapturedEvidence before the gate, capture all fixed gate files through its protected bounded reader, parse those exact snapshots, validate exact stage/kind/revision/attempt and success/failure/exit consistency, and retain those captured admission files. Keep successful primary retention mandatory before any history write and require a completed, stopped, reaped observer
findings.minimal_regression: A controlled redirected/hardlinked gate file must fail before its bytes are consumed; wrong attempt/kind and mismatched qualifier/observer success must reject. No tracked target may exist after any admission refusal

findings.issue: Published historical hashes describe intended bytes without verifying actual retained bytes
findings.evidence: The helper creates the tracked target and uses ordinary write_bytes/write_text, then reports passed=True without protected readback of artifacts or exact serialized disposition. The retained_hash fields are calculated from prepared buffers, so a replaced or corrupted target file can leave a successful disposition whose commitments do not match the published corpus. Target ancestor safety is not validated before these writes
findings.minimal_fix: Validate the fixed target and existing ancestors, use fresh exclusive/no-replace publication, then read all retained files through the protected reader and compare their exact hashes and intended serialized disposition before completion. Refuse any publication drift; do not issue success metadata for an incomplete corpus
findings.minimal_regression: In a fresh isolated public output tree, replace one written artifact or the disposition between write and final verification; retention must fail and must not publish a successful completion. A redirected target ancestor must be refused before a write
